assessments.reasoning: Mozilla’s registered media URL supplied the publisher baseline on the cutoff date. Its complete 16,726-byte body reproduced SHA-256 3f3d9e0024b1921b067d6f7f88deb4a60cbe7a78e76c64e3f1d7fc3b779b9d04. The line feed at offset 1282 and the suffix through end of file establish the direction and extent of the SPDX insertion.

The pinned spdx/license-list-data path text/MPL-2.0.txt returned HTTP 200 at 14:54:35 UTC on the cutoff date. Its full license body reproduced the claimed SPDX size and digest. Direct comparison established both its equality with the other generated file and its single extra space relative to Mozilla.

A separate HTTP 200 acquisition at 14:54:28 UTC on the cutoff date selected text/MPL-2.0-no-copyleft-exception.txt at the same SPDX commit. Its body spans the license title through Exhibit B. Its verified size, digest and exact equality with text/MPL-2.0.txt establish that the distinct filename yields the same generated bytes, including the space at offset 1282.

limitations: The frozen claim identifies commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 as its SPDX 3.29.0 snapshot. Both original file URLs select that commit. The six acquisitions do not include a separate release-tag record.
The response records identify endpoints and retrieval times on 2026-11-23 but supply no geographic location. The result applies to the sampled Mozilla body and the two pinned SPDX text files.

The measurements establish no conclusion about SPDX JSON-LD properties, matching templates, rendered pages, application headers, legal equivalence, redistribution permission or a particular project's notice.
